REFERRED TO RACING, GAMING AND WAGERING

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in relation
to the definition of wager and the licensing of mobile sports wagering
operators
items.lawSection: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S1962

SPONSOR: ADDABBO
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in
relation to the definition of wager and the licensing of mobile sports
wagering operators

 
PURPOSE:

To update the law related to promotional credits, to codify the existing
tax rates, and to license additional operators.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Adds "thing of value" to the definition of sports wager.

Section 2: amends the definition of "sports wagering gross revenue" to
exclude wagers placed with promotional credits.

Section 3: Clarifies that the taxes paid under this section shall be in
lieu of all other state and local taxes.

Section 4: Allows loses to be carried forward from previous month in
determining overall revenue

Section 5: Codifies the tax rates to be paid, establishes an application
process, and directs the Commission to allow a total of fourteen mobile
operators.

Section 6: Provides act shall take effect immediately.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

New York State recently authorized mobile sports betting in New York and
licensed nine operators. While there has been an exciting start to
mobile sports wagering in New York, there is still room for improvement.
This legislation would clarify and update the laws governing the current
operations and would direct the Gaming Commission to issue additional
mobile sports wagering licenses so that we can continue to grow and
improve the market.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2022: S. 8471 - Reported to Finance

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Amends the definition of sports wager to include other things of value; changes the licensing requirement for mobile sports wagering operators; provides the state shall by no later than January 31, 2024 have fourteen operators and by January 31, 2025 have sixteen operators; provides tax rates shall be determined based on the number of operators.
title: Amends the definition of wager and changes the licensing requirements for mobile sports wagering operators
